The description omits the left and right y-axis labels and units for both subplots (IMF Fiscal Index, debt ratio for total and central government).
The description omits the distinction between the two subplots (total state debt vs. central state debt) and the correct trends for the red and blue lines in each subplot.
The figure does not contain a purple line; this is a hallucinated visual element.
